summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending September 30, 2024, and September 30, 2023. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, among other financial indicators. Notably, revenues increased by 4.4%, while gross profit saw a growth of 4.8%. Operating expenses rose by 4.9%, with selling and marketing expenses increasing by 7.2%. The net profit before minority interest grew by 6.0%, and the diluted EPS increased by 16.7%, indicating a positive trend in financial performance year-over-year.
